ERR_UART_BAD_ARG.message: A UART request is not valid

ERR_UART_BAD_PORT.message: This board has no link to another board (UART {port})
ERR_UART_BAD_PORT.hint: Turn the link on in the firmware's configuration (SYS_UART_LINK).

ERR_UART_BAD_BAUD.message: {baud} is not a baud rate this UART takes

ERR_UART_NOT_DIRECT.message: Provider {provider} is not a UART port in direct mode

ERR_UART_TIMEOUT.message: UART provider {provider} did not finish sending in time
ERR_UART_TIMEOUT.hint: Check the rate, and the CTS line if the port uses flow control.

ERR_UART_IN_USE.message: UART port {port} is in use by device {owner}
ERR_UART_IN_USE.hint: A driver, a session or a stream reads this port: its messages go to them, not to this command.

ERR_UART_NOT_OWNER.message: UART port {port} is lent to device {owner}
